summary: C++ exception-throw wrapper. Constructs an std::ios_base::failure exception object via sub_59A854, throws it through CxxThrowException8 with the ios_base::failure type-info global, then runs destructor cleanup with SEH vtable reset. If the ownership flag bit 0 of the stack buffer is set, the wrapped heap pointer is released through FreeWrapper_7bcf; the pointer is then returned.

local_names.this: exception construction context passed to sub_59A854
local_names.a2: argument forwarded into the exception construction
local_names.v2: register-held context pointer (ecx) captured before the throw
local_names.v3: pointer subject to conditional cleanup, returned at exit
local_names.v5: stack buffer whose bit 0 of byte 4 records whether the wrapped allocation is owned
local_names.savedregs: saved register frame anchor used by the destructor cleanup

operations.description: sub_59A854 constructs the std::ios_base::failure exception object from the given context
CxxThrowException8 raises the exception using the stack buffer v5 and the ios_base::failure type-info global
DestructorWithSEHVTableReset runs destructor cleanup with an SEH vtable reset anchored on savedregs
If ownership flag bit 0 of stack buffer byte 4 (v5[4] & 1) is set, the wrapped heap pointer v3 is released
FreeWrapper_7bcf frees the heap-allocated buffer pointed to by v3 when the ownership flag is set
